configuration.change_oracle: independently compare canonical source values and declared tool versions; assert observed transitions match; then use initial IDs for shared query roots
configuration.claim_scope: authored mutations and compositions over a frozen subset of public retail transactions; not independent observed production incidents
configuration.dense_cache: clear encoder passage/query memo at each case; model weights loaded once
configuration.dense_document_score: maximum cosine across all overlapping chunks
configuration.evidence_aliases: unchanged deterministic logical/content/recipe/input-version aliases from pilot-v1
configuration.execution_order: rotate the predeclared arm list by SHA256(case_id) modulo its length
configuration.expected_refusal: one unchanged batch refresh; exact MissingEvidenceError naming an actually removed source may pass only if every available artifact is fresh+oracle-equal and every unavailable artifact blocks; refusal remains visible
configuration.graph_matched_budget: measured serialized unlimited graph closure tokens for this case; may be zero; adaptive diagnostic
configuration.primary_closure: each production arm must also identify the exact independently declared affected set; recursive repair cannot hide omitted closure evidence
configuration.primary_correctness: all planned cases; graph, exact_flat and full_context oracle-correct and equal semantic endstates for every scoped artifact; unexpected errors/incomplete runs fail
configuration.primary_ratio: sum(graph evidence tokens) / sum(full_context evidence tokens) over every planned case
configuration.reader: unchanged deterministic transitive reader restricted to returned evidence
configuration.scope: candidate scope applied equally before packing; independent dependency oracle closes full declarations before filtering
configuration.semantic_endstate: logical artifact name, currentness state, stored JSON value, original artifact preservation; raw UUIDs excluded
configuration.shared_executor: Every arm uses Hydra-assisted currentness and recursive refresh; standalone BM25/vector safety and LLM task success are not evaluated.

database: HydraDB OSS native FLOW traversal; no fallback
isolation: private manifest heads/blobs, shared immutable original graph; all selections frozen before arm executions
